prompt: A toy machine has 16 frames (bitmap byte 0 covers frames 0-7), all marked used at start. The memory map has one usable region: base `0x2800`, length `0x5000`, so bytes `0x2800` up to `0x7800`.

trace.label: Bitmap byte 0 after the region is added
Then `0x4800` to `0x5800` is reserved. Bitmap byte 0 now

explain: Adding a usable region rounds inward: the start 0x2800 rounds up to frame 3 (0x3000) and the end 0x7800 rounds down to 0x7000, so frames 3, 4, 5 and 6 are freed (frame 2 and frame 7 are only partly inside). Clearing bits 3-6 of 0xFF leaves 1000 0111 = 0x87. Reserving rounds outward: 0x4800 to 0x5800 touches frames 4 and 5, so both are set again, leaving only bits 3 and 6 clear: 1011 0111 = 0xB7. pmm_alloc takes the lowest zero bit, frame 3, address 3 * 4096 = 0x3000.
